payload.message: 读取 /root/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-backup/SKILL.md，执行每周 slim 备份。先检查固定配置文件及权限，不得输出任何凭据。运行 /root/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-backup/scripts/openclaw-backup.sh slim --prune。成功时只简要报告资产名和 Release URL，失败时报告不含秘密的错误阶段。

读取 /root/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-backup/SKILL.md，执行季度 full 备份。先检查固定配置文件及权限，不得输出任何凭据。运行 /root/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-backup/scripts/openclaw-backup.sh full --prune。成功时只简要报告资产名和 Release URL，失败时报告不含秘密的错误阶段。
